model_version_note: December 2023 launch — established DeepSeek as low-cost frontier competitor
notes: DeepSeek V2 launched December 2023 at $0.14/$0.28 per 1M tokens. 128K context window. Cheaper than GPT-4o ($5/$15) by 35x on input. Part of a wave of Chinese model exporters driving prices down. Source: DeployBase LLM pricing history.

model_version_note: December 2024 launch — frontier-quality open model at flash prices. Sparked price war concerns.
notes: DeepSeek V3 launched December 2024 at $0.27/$1.10 per 1M tokens. 128K context window. Frontier-quality open-weight model at flash-tier prices. Triggered major pricing pressure on OpenAI and others. 90% cache discount drops effective input to $0.028/MTok. Source: TokenCost AI Price Index and various pricing aggregators.

model_version_note: Successor to V3 — same $0.28/$0.42 output, 90% prompt cache discount
notes: DeepSeek V3.2 at $0.28/$0.42 per 1M tokens. 128K context window. 90% prompt cache discount drops effective input cost to $0.028/MTok — making it one of the cheapest frontier models when cache hits are high. Source: APIScout LLM API pricing comparison March 2026.

price_tier_note: 90% prompt cache discount drops effective input from $0.28 to $0.028/MTok
notes: DeepSeek V3.2 90% cache discount: effective input $0.028/MTok vs $0.28 standard. Comparable to Gemini 3 Flash cached rate. For high-cache workloads (agent sessions, repeated system prompts) this is a major cost advantage. Source: APIScout LLM API pricing comparison March 2026.

model_version_note: Reasoning model — launched with V3 family
notes: DeepSeek R1 at $0.55/$2.19 per 1M tokens. Reasoning model. 128K context window. Cheaper reasoning than OpenAI's o-series. Source: APIScout LLM API pricing comparison March 2026.

model_version_note: 1M context — January 2026 price, then May 25 2026 cut to permanent $0.435/$0.87
notes: DeepSeek V4 Pro launched early 2026 at $0.66/$1.98 per 1M tokens, 1M context window. Near-budget pricing with premium capabilities — biggest surprise in May 2026 per APIpulse. May 25 2026: cut to permanent $0.435/$0.87. Source: ChatForest LLM API pricing comparison May 2026.

DeepSeek V4 Pro permanent rate: $0.435/$0.87 per 1M tokens, 1M context window. 34% cut from $0.66/$1.98. Permanent rate per ChatForest. Undercuts Gemini 2.5 Pro ($1.25/$10) by 2.9x on input and 11.5x on output while offering same 1M context. Source: ChatForest LLM API pricing comparison May 26 2026.

model_version_note: 1M context — initially $0.22/$0.28, then cut to $0.14/$0.28 in January 2026
notes: DeepSeek V4 Flash at $0.22/$0.28 per 1M tokens, 1M context window. Highest throughput/cost ratio. Source: APIpulse State of LLM pricing May 2026. Note: V4 Flash later cut to $0.14/$0.28 — matching GPT-4o mini's output but at 1M context vs 128K.

model_version_note: January 2026 cut — undercuts GPT-4o mini on output at 1M context
notes: DeepSeek V4 Flash cut to $0.14/$0.28 per 1M tokens. 1M context window. Output matches GPT-4o mini's $0.60 but at less than half the price, with 8x more context. 'Highest throughput/cost' per ChatForest. Competes with GPT-4o mini at $0.15/$0.60. Source: ChatForest LLM API pricing comparison May 26 2026.

price_tier_note: Batch API: 50% off standard rates ($0.14/$0.28 -> $0.07/$0.14). 24-hour SLA.
notes: DeepSeek V4 Flash batch: $0.07/$0.14 per 1M tokens. 50% off standard. 1M context. Source: ChatForest LLM API pricing comparison May 26 2026.

price_tier_note: Batch API: 50% off standard rates ($0.435/$0.87 -> $0.2175/$0.435). 24-hour SLA.
notes: DeepSeek V4 Pro batch: $0.2175/$0.435 per 1M tokens. 50% off permanent rate. 1M context. Undercuts GPT-5 batch ($0.625/$5.00) by 2.9x on input. Source: ChatForest LLM API pricing comparison May 26 2026.
